```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP <- sprintf(
    readCaption("tbl.SRS"),
    .requireOneTarget(.currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "SRS table caption")
  )
}
if (!exists("PathSRS", inherits = FALSE)) {
  if (exists("SRS.target", inherits = FALSE)) {
    PathSRS <- file.path(root, "gmsp", "match", SRS.target)
  } else {
    SRS_ROOT <- file.path(root, "gmsp", "match")
    SRS_RUNS <- list.dirs(SRS_ROOT, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
    if (length(SRS_RUNS) != 1L) {
      stop("SRS table: set SRS.target or PathSRS before including _tbl/SRS.qmd.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    PathSRS <- SRS_RUNS[[1L]]
    SRS.target <- basename(PathSRS)
  }
}
```

&nbsp;

```{r}
#| label: tbl-srs-records
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "tbl", "SRS.R"))
TBL
```
